rows.jyutping: jyun4 cyun4 mou5 fui3 ji3 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone acts without showing any remorse.

example.english: They walked away completely remorselessly after injuring someone.
example.traditional: 佢撞傷人之後，完全冇悔意咁走咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zong6 soeng1 jan4 zi1 hau6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 fui3 ji3 gam3 zau2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the remorseless action is also ruthless or gives the other person no mercy.

example.traditional: 對手毫不留情咁追住我哋打。
example.jyutping: deoi3 sau2 hou4 bat1 lau1 cing4 gam3 zeoi1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 daa2

rows.jyutping: jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 fui3 goi2 gam3
rows.note: Use this when the person keeps doing wrong and shows no sign of repentance or reform.

example.english: They keep cheating people completely remorselessly despite having made so many mistakes.
example.traditional: 佢犯咗咁多次錯，仲係完全唔知悔改咁周圍呃人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 faan6 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 co3 zung6 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 fui3 goi2 gam3 zau1 wai4 ngaak1 jan4
